name: server-alias-getattr-delegation
title: Delegate the server.py ops alias block through module __getattr__
description: Replace the 187 consumer-less NAME = _server_ops.NAME lines in server.py's compatibility block with a module __getattr__ that delegates to server_ops, binding explicitly only the 40 names server.py reads as bare globals or that other in-repo code reads as server.<name>, so every future server_ops extraction stops needing an alias line.
creator: sdelmas
